'''Dark Squadron''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] that flew [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]]. The squadron was made up of some of the best [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and they were given the best equipment and underwent sophisticated training programs. The squadron was assigned to become part of the [[Byss Defense Fleet]]&mdash;led by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilder Varth]]
and [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Valin Draco]]&mdash;and subsequently participated in the [[Battle of Byss]] against the [[Alderaanian Resistance]].<ref name="JOTS">{{DoD|Jaws of the Sarlacc}}</ref>

After [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] death at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Dark Squadron worked for his [[Dark Empire]] following his rebirth in a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] body.
